description: This file defines an abstract class 'DisabledTransactionsTestRunner' that extends 'TransactionTestRunnerBase'. It provides methods to test that certain transaction-related grains throw 'OrleansTransactionsDisabledException' when transactions are attempted, indicating that transactions are disabled in this test context.

classes.name: DisabledTransactionsTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class for testing that transaction grains throw exceptions when transactions are disabled.

methods.name: TransactionGrainsThrowWhenTransactions
methods.description: Tests that a transaction grain throws 'OrleansTransactionsDisabledException' when a transaction is attempted.

methods.name: MultiTransactionGrainsThrowWhenTransactions
methods.description: Tests that multiple transaction grains throw 'OrleansTransactionsDisabledException' when a multi-grain transaction is attempted.
